digest.component_or_area: ticket store resolution and path composition
propositions: bridge_status fails with ENOENT on `.tickets-tracker/.env-id` when the store is relocated outside the repo root and REBAR_TRACKER_DIR is set, despite config.tracker_dir() supporting this configuration
13 shipped code paths compose store paths using hardcoded `.tickets-tracker` literals, bypassing the documented resolver that honors REBAR_TRACKER_DIR and absolute tracker.dir config values
last_pass.py hardcodes `.tickets-tracker` path composition at lines 35 and 89 while its caller passes repo_root instead of the resolved tracker directory, causing relocation to be silently ignored

rebar list (which uses the resolver) succeeds on a relocated store while rebar bridge status fails on the same store with identical environment, proving the failure is path-composition not store corruption

the defect was introduced in commit fe5a447061cde which created last_pass.py; config.tracker_dir() already carried the relocation contract at that commit's parent, making this a plan_defect not a regression
